Ask Claude Code for a short film; expect heavy token use.

AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev.what: A community field guide to TypeSafe's System One model, with SDKs, live demos, agent tools, and independent evaluations.
AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev.why: To help developers explore TypeSafe's Jev model for typed judgments, structured outputs, and semantic routing while keeping application code in control.
AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev.caution: This repository is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe AI.
AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev.plain: A community list of guides, demos and tools for TypeSafe's AI model that makes quick, structured decisions.
useFor: Find demos of AI sorting support tickets
Pick an SDK to add AI decisions to your app
Compare independent reviews of the Jev model
steps: Browse the list, starting with the Start here section.
Create an API key in the TypeSafe Console.
In a terminal, run `npm install @typesafe-ai/sdk`, then try the README's first-decision example.

ruc-datalab/EvoOntology.what: An agent plugin that builds and continuously evolves a versioned semantic ontology layer for data agents over heterogeneous tables and databases.
ruc-datalab/EvoOntology.why: Raw data lacks explicit business definitions, causing agents to make semantic errors and repeatedly explore the same data. It is useful when you need data agents to maintain a consistent, workload-grounded knowledge layer that adapts over time.
ruc-datalab/EvoOntology.caution: The repository is a research prototype from Renmin University of China. It integrates directly with coding agent plugins like Claude Code and Codex, which may interact with your local environment or external APIs.
ruc-datalab/EvoOntology.plain: A research add-on that helps AI assistants understand your company's tables and databases, improving as it's used.
useFor: Help an AI answer questions across messy spreadsheets
Map what columns mean across several databases
Give Claude Code a shared glossary for your data
steps: Install Claude Code or Codex first.
In a terminal, run `claude plugin marketplace add ruc-datalab/EvoOntology`, then install the plugin following the README.
Point it at your data; it is a university research prototype, so test on copies.

paperclipai/paperclip.what: An open-source server and React UI that coordinates teams of AI agents using org charts, budgets, governance, and goal alignment.
paperclipai/paperclip.why: It solves the chaos of running multiple disparate coding agents or automation bots simultaneously, allowing you to manage them like a structured company with tasks, roles, and budgets instead of scattered terminal tabs.
paperclipai/paperclip.caution: The repository has not been updated recently (pushed over 4 months ago), and orchestrating multiple autonomous agents with live code access and provider tokens carries inherent security risks and potential for runaway costs.
paperclipai/paperclip.plain: Free software that runs a team of AI agents like a company, with roles, budgets and goals.
useFor: Set up AI agents with job roles and a manager
Give AI workers spending limits and goals
Track what each agent is working on
steps: Try it without installing: in a terminal, run `npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai onboard --yes`.
For a permanent setup, download and run the install script shown in the README Quickstart.
Set budgets before starting agents to avoid surprise AI costs.

stablyai/orca.what: An agent development environment designed for running and managing multiple parallel coding agents across isolated git worktrees.
stablyai/orca.why: It solves the chaos of juggling multiple terminal sessions when running concurrent AI coding tasks, helping you orchestrate prompts across several agents at once. Reach for it when you want to compare outputs from different agents side-by-side in separate worktrees.
stablyai/orca.caution: Using third-party interfaces to drive consumer subscription services like Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot may violate their provider terms and risk account suspension.
stablyai/orca.plain: A desktop app for running several AI coding assistants side by side on the same project.
useFor: Send one task to five coding agents and compare
Keep each agent's changes separate until you pick one
Check on running agents from your phone
steps: Download Orca for macOS, Windows or Linux from its download page.
Open a project and connect the coding assistants you already use.
Using consumer subscriptions through third-party apps may break provider terms, so check first.

HKUDS/CLI-Anything.what: CLI-Anything makes desktop and web software agent-native by providing community-built command-line interface harnesses and a central registry.
HKUDS/CLI-Anything.why: It bridges the gap between AI coding agents and complex software packages that lack native agent support, making it useful when you need an agent to automate apps like CAD tools, editors, or databases.
HKUDS/CLI-Anything.caution: The repository has not been updated in over four months.
HKUDS/CLI-Anything.plain: A collection of ready-made command tools that let AI agents control desktop apps like GIMP and Blender.
useFor: Let an AI agent edit images in GIMP
Control desktop software with simple commands
Build a command tool so agents can use an app
steps: Install Python and the desktop app you want the agent to control.
In a terminal, run `pip install cli-anything-hub`.
Install a ready-made tool, such as cli-hub install gimp, then let your agent use it.

debpalash/VoiceStudio.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice cloning, text-to-speech, transcription, and video dubbing tool.
debpalash/VoiceStudio.why: It is designed for performing audio generation and voice cloning locally without relying on paid cloud services. Reach for it when you want open-source voice design, dictation, and audiobook creation.
debpalash/VoiceStudio.caution: Running large local models requires significant hardware resources such as a compatible GPU.
debpalash/VoiceStudio.plain: A free app for cloning voices, reading text aloud, transcribing and dubbing video, all on your own computer.
useFor: Dub a video into another language
Turn a script into a voiceover in your voice
Transcribe interviews without uploading them anywhere
steps: On macOS or Linux, run `curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh` in a terminal.
Or paste the README's install prompt into Claude Code or Codex to install it for you.
Expect large downloads and a capable graphics card for the bigger models.

vectorize-io/hindsight.what: An agent memory system designed to help AI agents learn over time rather than just recall conversation history.
vectorize-io/hindsight.why: Use this when you want your AI agents to maintain long-term memory, learn from experiences, and avoid the limitations of traditional RAG and knowledge graphs.
vectorize-io/hindsight.start: docker run -it --pull always --name hindsight --restart unless-stopped -p 8888:8888 -p 9999:9999 -e HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY ghcr.io/vectorize-io/hindsight:latest
vectorize-io/hindsight.caution: Reuses consumer subscription logins (such as ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor/Copilot apps) as an API or pools free tiers, which may break the provider's terms and risk the account.
vectorize-io/hindsight.plain: A memory system that helps AI agents learn from past experience, not just remember old chats.
useFor: Give a support bot memory of each customer
Let an agent learn from its earlier mistakes
Share learned knowledge across several AI agents
steps: Install Docker and get an OpenAI API key.
Start the server with the docker run command from the README Quick Start.
Open http://localhost:9999 for the dashboard and connect your agent as the docs show.

VectifyAI/PageIndex.what: A vectorless, reasoning-based RAG engine that uses hierarchical tree indexes and LLM reasoning for traceable document retrieval without vector databases or chunking.
VectifyAI/PageIndex.why: Traditional vector similarity search often retrieves irrelevant context or misses facts in long, complex professional documents. Reach for PageIndex when you need precise, explainable retrieval over legal, financial, or technical PDFs.
VectifyAI/PageIndex.caution: Requires external API keys (such as OpenAI) to build indexes and run queries.
VectifyAI/PageIndex.plain: Lets AI find answers in long documents by reading them like a table of contents, with page references.
useFor: Ask questions about a long financial report
Find exact sections in contracts with page references
Build a document Q&A tool that shows its sources
steps: Install Python and get an API key, such as from OpenAI.
In a terminal, run `pip install -U pageindex`.
Follow the README examples to index a PDF and ask questions about it.

Tencent/WeKnora.what: Tencent's open-source knowledge platform turns raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
Tencent/WeKnora.why: Teams need a central hub to ingest multi-format documents, auto-sync from external wikis, and let users chat or run agentic tasks over verified internal knowledge.
Tencent/WeKnora.caution: Requires running multiple backend containers via Docker Compose and configuring external LLM providers or local Ollama instances.
Tencent/WeKnora.plain: Tencent's free platform that turns your documents into a searchable knowledge base you can chat with.
useFor: Ask questions across all company manuals and policies
Build an internal wiki that updates itself from documents
Run a document chatbot with a local model
steps: Install Docker, Docker Compose and Git.
In a terminal, clone the repository, copy .env.example to .env, then run `docker compose up -d`.
Open http://localhost in your browser and follow the setup guide.

trycua/cua.what: Cua provides open-source desktop automation, isolated cloud desktops, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and benchmarks for evaluating computer-use agents.
trycua/cua.why: It lets AI agents interact with graphical operating systems, desktop applications, and browsers across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Reach for it when building or evaluating autonomous computer-use agents.
trycua/cua.caution: Granting an AI agent direct control over your computer's native apps and desktop can lead to unintended actions or accidental file modifications if not properly sandboxed.
trycua/cua.plain: Tools that let AI agents safely use a computer's apps, including isolated practice desktops and test tasks.
useFor: Let an AI agent operate desktop apps for you
Run agents inside a separate virtual Mac
Test how well an agent completes computer tasks
steps: On macOS or Linux, run `/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"` in a terminal; Windows has a PowerShell line.
Connect your agent, such as Claude Code, following the drive-your-first-app tutorial.
Start in a sandbox or virtual machine so mistakes cannot touch your files.

cloudflare/security-audit-skill.what: A coding-agent skill that coordinates multi-phase security audits with isolated hunting and independent verification.
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.why: Automates thorough, multi-stage vulnerability discovery and reporting in codebases when you want structured security assessments from your coding agent.
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.caution: Requires an OS-enforced sandbox to safely handle target-controlled builds, tests, and fuzzers; running untrusted code without one carries significant risk.
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.plain: Cloudflare's add-on that walks AI coding assistants through a careful security check of your code.
useFor: Find security holes in a web app's code
Get each finding double-checked before you see it
Audit a project before launching it
steps: Set up a sandboxed environment first, as the README requires.
In a terminal, run `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit`.
Inside your coding assistant, ask it to run a security audit on your project.

t8y2/dbx.what: A lightweight cross-platform database client supporting over 100 databases with built-in AI, MCP server, CLI, desktop app, and Docker.
t8y2/dbx.why: It provides a single compact tool to connect to and manage numerous database systems ranging from MySQL and PostgreSQL to SQLite, Redis, and MongoDB. Reach for it when you need a fast, multi-database manager with AI assistance and MCP server capabilities.
t8y2/dbx.plain: A small free app for browsing and editing databases, with a built-in AI that writes queries for you.
useFor: Look inside a company database without learning SQL
Ask AI to write a query from a plain request
Let Claude Code read your databases through MCP
steps: Download DBX from the project's latest release page.
On Windows you can instead run `winget install t8y2.dbx` in a terminal.
Add a database connection, then describe what you want and let the AI write the query.

dream-num/univer.what: Univer is a high-performance open-source Office SDK and harness designed for embedding customizable spreadsheets, documents, and presentations into applications and AI workflows.
dream-num/univer.why: It provides a unified runtime and Facade API that works both in the browser and in Node.js, allowing developers and AI agents to programmatically create, edit, and collaborate on Office documents.
dream-num/univer.caution: Integrates complex canvas rendering and plugin architecture which requires a steep learning curve and careful dependency management.
dream-num/univer.plain: A free toolkit for building spreadsheets, documents and slides into your own web apps and AI tools.
useFor: Add an Excel-like spreadsheet to your web app
Let an AI agent fill in and calculate spreadsheets
Process workbooks on a server without a screen
steps: Install Node.js and a package manager like pnpm.
Add the Univer packages to your web project, as the README Quick Start lists.
Follow the getting-started guide to show a spreadsheet on your page.

NVIDIA/OpenShell.what: OpenShell is a safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents that enforces kernel-level file, network, and system call policies.
NVIDIA/OpenShell.why: It lets you give autonomous agents the file access, package installation, and API capabilities they need while restricting them from accessing unauthorized data, secrets, or networks through formal verification and isolated sandboxes.
NVIDIA/OpenShell.plain: NVIDIA's free safety box for AI agents that controls which files, websites and actions they can reach.
useFor: Run a coding agent without risking your personal files
Block an agent from reaching unknown websites
Approve new access only when an agent asks
steps: Use Linux, an Apple Silicon Mac, or Windows with WSL 2, plus Docker or Podman.
In a terminal, run `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh`.
Create a sandbox with openshell sandbox create --name demo, then follow the Run Your First Agent guide.
